Interface ProductJsonConverter

All Known Implementing Classes:
JacksonProductJsonConverter
public interface ProductJsonConverter
Defines JSON conversion operations for Product entities. Provides conversion for a single Product and for Product lists.
Author:
Nikita Smiichyk (primary)
